title: coord exchanges claims with any external coordination service through a JSON-lines contract: live intents and touches out, external reservations in as overlaps
goal: coord.py export-intents prints each live intent with its session, items and touch globs as JSON lines; coord.py import-reservations FILE|- takes JSON lines of holder, path globs, expiry and source and stores them as leases of their own that expire on their own; digest and the coord hook show an imported reservation that meets a session's touches as an overlap, as they show a session's; the contract is documented in coordination.md with no product named; on a temp store an imported reservation's holder appears in the digest.

run: import json,os,subprocess as s,sys,tempfile;d=tempfile.mkdtemp();t=os.path.join(d,'c.sqlite');f=os.path.join(d,'r.jsonl');open(f,'w').write(json.dumps({'holder':'ext-agent-1','paths':['src/auth/*'],'expires_in':600,'source':'external'})+chr(10));a=s.run([sys.executable,'_tools/coord.py','import-reservations',f,'--store',t],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=60);b=s.run([sys.executable,'_tools/coord.py','digest','--store',t],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=60);print(a.stdout,a.stderr,b.stdout);sys.exit(0 if a.returncode==0 and b.returncode==0 and 'ext-agent-1' in b.stdout else 1)

gates.question: Does an imported external reservation refuse a coord claim on the same paths, or only show as an overlap?
options: only show as an overlap, like a session's touches
refuse a claim whose touches it covers until it expires
gates.recommendation: only show as an overlap, like a session's touches
gates.reason: the coord hook never blocks, and the operator decides
gates.answer: only show as an overlap, like a session's touches
